subject: Weekly funnel starts on Sunday
description: Our weekly funnel buckets start on Sunday but our reporting week runs Monday to Sunday. Is there a setting for this?
latest_comment: Week start is a project setting (Settings > Project > Calendar). Switched to Monday for the customer. (agent Dario Lenz)

subject: Bulk export of all dashboards and saved reports
description: Is there a way to export every dashboard definition and saved report in one go, with the underlying queries? We need a full inventory of what we've built by the end of the month.
latest_comment: Pointed the customer to the reporting API (GET /dashboards with include=queries). No bulk UI export today. Customer said it's for an internal comparison exercise. (agent Dario Lenz)

subject: Share dashboard with people outside analytics
description: Can I share a dashboard with colleagues who don't have a login yet, read only?
latest_comment: Explained public links and that inviting them is free, since seats are unlimited. Sent the invite guide. (agent Anouk Visser)

subject: Usage alert at 80% - correct?
description: We got an automatic mail saying we've hit 80% of our yearly event allowance. It's only August. Is this right? We did launch the app in Belgium, Germany and Austria in June.
latest_comment: Checked: yes, correct. Daily volume roughly doubled after the June launches; at the current rate the yearly allowance runs out around mid October. Looped in Ruben De Smet to discuss options. (agent Anouk Visser)

subject: Production approval of the mobile SDK
description: Our information security office cannot clear the Cairnpath SDK for the production app yet. We need the latest penetration test summary, the full list of subprocessors with locations, and written confirmation that event data stays in the EU region. Until then the SDK stays out of the release.
latest_comment: Sent the pen test summary and subprocessor list on 20 Aug. EU residency letter is with Legal, no date yet. Customer chased on 29 Sep. (agent Tobias Hagen)

subject: Only events from the staging laptop arrive
description: The only events we see in Cairnpath come from Florian's test laptop. How do we set the production key in the app build? Our developers are unsure which key goes where.
latest_comment: Sent the environment setup guide and offered a screen share with the app developers. Waiting for a slot. (agent Tobias Hagen)

subject: Retention cohorts by first purchase
description: Can retention cohorts be grouped by the month of first ticket purchase instead of sign-up?
latest_comment: Yes: set the cohort start event to purchase_completed. Showed it on a short call. (agent Anouk Visser)

subject: Bot traffic counted against our allowance
description: The overage charge for Q2 comes from the bot attack on our ticket shop in May (your support confirmed it under ticket LUB-7614). We will not pay for traffic that was never real visitors. Please cancel the overage and send a corrected statement.
latest_comment: Finance reviewing whether filtered bot events can be credited. Customer has put the payment on hold until then. Escalated to Camille Roux. (agent Anouk Visser)

subject: Daily learners twice our own count
description: Daily active learners in Cairnpath are roughly double what our own database shows. Looks like session_start fires twice when someone reloads a lesson page.
latest_comment: Confirmed: the web snippet was included twice in the lesson template. Customer removed it on 21 June. Past days cannot be corrected. (agent Dario Lenz)

subject: Android events have no user since app 5.2
description: Since release 5.2 of our Android app, nearly all events arrive without a user id, so half our funnels are full of anonymous learners and the retention chart has collapsed.
latest_comment: Their 5.2 build calls identify() before the SDK is initialised. Sent a code sample; customer fix planned for app 5.4. Gap in the data until then. (agent Dario Lenz)

subject: ISO 27001 certificate and NIS2 supplier checklist
description: Our group procurement needs your ISO 27001 certificate and answers to the attached NIS2 supplier checklist (62 questions) by 25 September. Without them we cannot be scored.
latest_comment: Certificate sent. Checklist passed to the trust team; 48 of 62 answered so far, the incident notification questions still open. (agent Tobias Hagen)

subject: Switch build sends timestamps from 1970
description: Events from our Nintendo Switch build land on 1 January 1970. Looks like the console clock isn't read before the first event is sent.
latest_comment: Customer now sets the timestamp server side for that platform. Events from 1-28 June stay wrong; offered to drop them. (agent Dario Lenz)

subject: 429s on ingestion after launch
description: Since Tuesday's launch of Hollow Tide we're getting HTTP 429 from the ingestion endpoint at peak. We're 4x our usual traffic and losing events.
latest_comment: Raised the rate limit for the account temporarily. Note that at this volume the yearly commitment will be used up in weeks. Flagged to Harriet Okafor. (agent Dario Lenz)

subject: Shopify app installed, nothing shows up
description: We installed the Cairnpath app on our Shopify store ten days ago and the project is still empty. No page views, no orders. Did we miss a step?
latest_comment: The app needs the write key pasted in the app settings and the checkout extension enabled; neither is done. Sent steps twice, no reply since. (agent Anouk Visser)

subject: API rate limit for nightly sync
description: Our nightly job pulls chart results through the API and sometimes gets throttled. What's the limit?
latest_comment: 60 requests per minute per key. Suggested batching the queries. (agent Tobias Hagen)

subject: Credit note still not received
description: Second reminder from our accounts payable: we are still waiting for the credit note for the experiments module charged on the August bill. The amount stays blocked in our system until it arrives.
latest_comment: Contract check by Finance ongoing; the order form lists the module as included for the renewal year, the customer says it was to be removed. Matthias Brenner owns it. (agent Tobias Hagen)

subject: Drop IP addresses at ingestion
description: We need IP addresses removed before anything is stored, not just masked in the UI. This is a condition from our data protection impact assessment for the patient app.
latest_comment: Logged with Product. Today we truncate the last octet; full removal is on the roadmap with no date. Customer says this blocks their sign-off. (agent Tobias Hagen)

subject: Embed a dashboard in Confluence
description: Can we embed a live dashboard in a Confluence page for the clinical leads?
latest_comment: Yes, with the embed link from the share menu. Sent the steps. (agent Tobias Hagen)

subject: Delete an old test project
description: How do I delete the 'sandbox-2025' project? It has no data we need.
latest_comment: Deleted on the customer's request after confirmation by the admin. (agent Anouk Visser)

subject: Booking conversion above 100%
description: Our booking funnel shows 112% conversion from payment page to confirmation. Users who press back on the payment page seem to fire booking_confirmed again.
latest_comment: The confirmation page fires the event on every load. Customer added a once-per-booking guard on 6 July. Historic duplicates remain. (agent Dario Lenz)

subject: SDK init fails with invalid key on Android
description: Our Android build throws 'invalid key' on init. We copied the key from the project page. iOS hasn't been tried yet.
latest_comment: They used the API secret instead of the write key. Explained the difference; customer still sees the error after the change, waiting for logs. (agent Anouk Visser)

subject: Annotations on charts
description: Can we add annotations to charts for release days so editors understand the spikes?
latest_comment: Yes, from the chart menu (Add annotation), shared across the project. (agent Dario Lenz)

subject: Upgrade web SDK to 4.x
description: Is the move from web SDK 3.8 to 4.x breaking for us? We only use page views and the add_to_cart event.
latest_comment: Not breaking for that set-up. Shared the migration notes. (agent Anouk Visser)

subject: Dark mode for dashboards on the TV in the office
description: Our team shows a dashboard on a TV in the roastery. A dark theme would make it much easier to read.
latest_comment: Logged with Product as a request. (agent Anouk Visser)

subject: Compare retention of app and web buyers
description: Is there a way to compare 30-day retention of customers who bought in the app versus on the website, side by side?
latest_comment: Yes: segment the retention chart by platform of first purchase. Sent a saved example. (agent Tobias Hagen)

subject: UTM parameters on the first page view
description: Are UTM parameters stored on the first page view only, or on every event in the session?
latest_comment: First touch is stored as a user property, and each page view keeps its own UTM values. (agent Anouk Visser)
